attributes.text: Everything is encrypted on this phone (XChaCha20-Poly1305). The key is kept in Android's protected storage for this app only and is not included in Android backups. If you lose this phone and have no recovery secret, everything here is gone for good. Nobody can reset it for you.
Test build, signed with the public Android test key. Not reviewed by anyone independent. Not tested on a physical phone by its builders.
Passed: A key was saved in the phone's protected storage and read back unchanged
